title: NG-SIEM Correlation Rule
description: Schema for a single correlation rule YAML file.

id.description: Falcon-assigned rule ID. Null for new rules; populated by the apply job on first successful create.

name.description: Human-readable rule name. Must be unique across the repo.

description.description: What the rule detects and why it matters. Optional on imported rules.

severity.description: Falcon severity tier. Only five values are accepted by the create API: 10 (Informational), 30 (Low), 50 (Medium), 70 (High), 90 (Critical). Other values cause a 400 'expected RuleCreateRequestV1.Severity to be one of: 10 30 50 70 90'.

status.description: active = deployed and firing; inactive = deployed but disabled server-side.

tactic.description: MITRE ATT&CK tactic ID ('TA0001'). Legacy imported rules may carry the name form, but the create API rejects it. Optional.

technique.description: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID (T1078, T1078.004) or CrowdStrike custom technique (CST0001). Optional.

coverage_category.description: Telemetry source the rule consumes. Bucket on the source, not the adversary behavior detected. endpoint = Falcon sensor + Linux audit + Windows EventLog + Sysmon + per-device network observation (proxy, firewall, DNS). cloud = AWS/Azure/GCP control- and data-plane (CloudTrail, Azure sign-in, GCP audit, VPC flow). identity = IDP and SaaS user-activity audit (Okta, Entra ID, M365, other SaaS audit logs).

log_source.description: Optional. If set, must match a key in schema/log_sources.json.

runbook_url.description: Optional. If set, link to the rule's runbook (wiki, Confluence, etc.).

owner.description: Optional. Owning team or individual email.

notes.description: Free-text tuning notes, exception history, etc.

filter.description: CQL query. Subject to the CQL format linter unless lifecycle.standardization_pending is true.

lookback.description: Query lookback window as Falcon stores it. Go-style multi-unit duration (e.g. '75m', '1h', '2h30m', '24h0m', '0h15m', '30s'). Zero-duration forms are caught by a dedicated lookback_zero check. Preserved verbatim from import.

definition.description: Schedule as Falcon stores it. Accepts Falcon's multi-unit interval form (@every 1h, @every 1h0m, @every 2h30m, @every 0h5m) or a standard 5-field cron expression. Preserved verbatim from import — do NOT translate between forms; they are not equivalent.

deletion_requested.description: Two-step delete flag. Set true in one MR, then rm the file in a follow-up MR.

standardization_pending.description: Set true by the bootstrap importer for rules not yet meeting the CQL format standard. Exempts the rule from format linter checks 2-4. Cleared by sweep MRs.

legacy_ids.description: Optional array of prior Falcon IDs, in case rule ID churn is observed.

jira_ticket.description: Optional ticket key (e.g. Jira) tracking the work for this rule. Tracking-only; absence does not block validation or CI.
